The signs remain useful for diagnostics but must not authorize foundational amplitude/timing claims during global revalidation #1594.
provenance.required_to_authorize: Independent hardware/DAQ polarity documentation or a source-bound raw-waveform polarity measurement whose data product lineage is itself validated.
provenance.note: Do not replace the missing polarity evidence with abs(raw-baseline). Downstream producers are expected to fail closed while this map is gated.
